'''Des'sein''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] with stubby fingers. As a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Des'sein represented a beleaguered [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was somewhere far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. He was also a member of the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] with his fellow Senators [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] and [[Largetto]].

==Biography==
In his life Des'sein was one of the more outspoken Senators in the [[Delegation of 2000]] and strongly opposed the measures taken by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], as a member of the the Republic Group, Des'sein received a package from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tobb Jadak|Jadak]]. The package received was said to contain data that was of great value to the Republic Group's cause. After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] Des'sein was informed by fellow Senator, Fang Zar, that Palpatine had been rescued from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] custody and that martial law on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had been rescinded. Even with that good news and the report of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] Des'sein believed it was vital for the Republic Group to continue it's work. As a result Des'sein asked Captain Jadak and his co-pilot [[Reeze Duurmun|Reeze]] to deliver the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] to [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Aren Folee]] in [[Salik City]] on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. He had told Jadak that the ''Stellar Envoy'' would be used to find a [[Insignia of Unity|treasure]] that would restore Republic honor the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="MillenniumFalcon" />

Unlike many of his compatriots, Des'sein survived Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and went on to become a business consultant. During his new career Des'sein had a flourishing friendship with [[Lestra Oxic]]. As a friend, Lestra made Des'sein's will and attended Des'sein's daughter's wedding. When Des'sein was dying from a congenital disease, Lestra traveled to Coruscant to be at his bedside. It was on his death bed that Des'sein told Lestra about the Republic Group, its treasure, and the means to find it.<ref name="MillenniumFalcon" />
